access: English Wowhead guide bodies inspected with assistant web access. No GitHub-hosted Wowhead fetch; no Chrome Translator API or French DOM replay.

pages.evidence: WotLK Enhancement leveling guide uses white hits in the melee swing/Lightning Weaving context.
Classic Rogue stat guide uses White Auto Attacks to distinguish ordinary weapon attacks from activated abilities.
Classic Hunter stat guide describes glancing blows and automatic attacks; independent ranged control, not direct evidence for the white-hit alias.

crossPageFix.concept: White hits are non-ability automatic weapon attacks; the same jargon applies to Shaman and Rogue, with Hunter as a boundary control.
crossPageFix.rationale: Translate a reusable WoW combat concept to coups blancs, not literal color; retain generic white, hits, clipping and official Auto Shot outside this rule.
crossPageFix.verification: English source and static locale/glossary tests only; browser output and DOM reconstruction not tested.

auditBoundary: This is a source-only intervention, not a measured translation-error rate or a clean quality cycle. Do not treat guide comments, locale-mixed pages or web text extraction artifacts as browser DOM bugs.
